findings.title: Public group member lists are silently truncated to 50 users
findings.body: The public `groups/:group_id/members` endpoint now defaults to 50 results for every group. The public group-members route calls `findMembers` only once, and `group/members.hbs` has no pagination or load-more controls, so visitors to any group with more than 50 members can never see members after the first username-ordered page. Previously non-automatic groups returned the full member list. Either retain the full response for this view or add public pagination before imposing this limit.

findings.title: Exact page-size member counts produce a nonexistent extra page
findings.body: `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` overcounts whenever the member count is exactly divisible by the page size. For example, a group with 50 members and a limit of 50 is shown as having two pages; clicking Next requests offset 50 and displays an empty page. Use a ceiling calculation (while preserving the zero-member case) so the final valid page is detected correctly.

findings.title: Refreshing after removing the last member of a page can leave the UI on an empty page
findings.body: The reload offset is clamped against the model's pre-request `user_count`, not the total after the membership mutation. For example, deleting the sole member on offset 50 of a 51-member group sends offset 50; the server then reports total 50 but returns no members at that offset, and the model retains the empty page. Normalize the offset using the returned total (and refetch if necessary), or have the endpoint clamp an out-of-range offset, so the last remaining valid page is displayed.

findings.title: Out-of-order member-list requests can overwrite the currently selected page
findings.body: Every `findMembers` response unconditionally replaces `offset` and `members`. The Next/Previous actions allow another request before the previous one finishes, so rapid navigation from offsets 0 to 50 to 100 can receive the offset-100 response first and then overwrite it with the late offset-50 response. The UI ends on stale data and the wrong page. Cancel prior requests or track a request/page token and ignore responses that are no longer current.

findings.title: The public members endpoint changes its JSON response contract without compatibility
findings.body: `GET /groups/:group_id/members(.json)` previously returned the serialized member array directly (the prior client consumed it with `result.map`). It now returns an object containing `members` and `meta`. Although the in-repository caller was updated, existing API consumers or plugins parsing this established endpoint as an array will break immediately. Preserve the old representation, introduce a versioned/paginated endpoint, or provide an explicit compatibility migration.
